title: feat(imap,mail): move newsgroups under News/ prefix; switch NAMESPACE delimiter to /
description:
Newsgroup mailboxes currently appear at the IMAP/JMAP root (e.g. comp.lang.rust). They must move to News/comp.lang.rust. The NAMESPACE delimiter must change from . to / so hierarchy-aware clients (Thunderbird, Apple Mail) can display the tree correctly.

What needs to be done:
1. Update mailbox_id_for_group() and all Mailbox/get responses to prefix newsgroup names with News/.
2. Change the IMAP NAMESPACE response from (("" ".")) to (("" "/")).
3. Update the IMAP delimiter used in LIST, LSUB, and SELECT responses.
4. Update JMAP Mailbox/get to return name=News and parentId=null for the News root, and name=<group> with parentId=<news-root-id> for each group.
5. Migrate any existing stored mailbox IDs (or document that IDs are stable by derivation and no migration is needed).
6. Add tests: IMAP LIST at root shows News/ with \HasChildren; JMAP Mailbox/get returns correct parentId chain.
